description: FDA approves Zilretta (triamcinolone acetonide extended-release; NDA 208845) for osteoarthritis pain of the knee
source: FDA approval letter, signed 6 October 2017 (the package cover sheet's 14 December 2017 is a cover-sheet discrepancy); data/raw/New Datasets/FDA Zilretta/208845Orig1s000Approv.pdf

description: Zilretta has OPPS transitional pass-through payment status (a hospital outpatient payment rule; office-based payment is unaffected)
source: CMS Transmittal 3988 (change request 10515, 2 March 2018) Table 5; CMS Transmittal 10666 (change request 12175, 8 March 2021) Table 11

description: Durolane (hyaluronic acid; J7318) has OPPS pass-through status over the same window as Zilretta
source: CMS Transmittal 3988 Table 5; CMS Transmittal 10666 Table 11

description: Zilretta receives its product-specific HCPCS code J3304
source: Flexion Therapeutics 10-K for 2018, accession 0001564590-19-005465 ("As of January 1, 2019, we received a product-specific J-Code for ZILRETTA (J-3304)")

description: Supplemental application S-011 submitted: post-marketing experience added to the adverse reactions section of the Zilretta label
source: FDA supplement approval letter for NDA 208845/S-011; data/raw/New Datasets/FDA Zilretta/208845Orig1s011ltr_2020.pdf

description: ACR and Arthritis Foundation osteoarthritis guideline: strong recommendation for intra-articular steroids in knee and hip OA, conditional recommendation against hyaluronic acid injections in knee OA
source: American College of Rheumatology press release dated 7 January 2020 (rheumatology.org)

description: World Health Organization assesses COVID-19 as a pandemic
United States declares a national emergency and states impose stay-at-home measures (date approximate: the source says mid-March 2020); in-person medical practice and promotion disrupted
AAOS knee osteoarthritis guideline (3rd edition): hyaluronic acid injection not recommended for routine use; no recommendation for or against corticosteroid injection
source: AAOS guideline page (aaos.org) via search result; the date and wording are to be confirmed against the document itself

description: Pacira and Flexion sign the merger agreement
Pacira completes the acquisition of Flexion; Zilretta moves from Flexion to Pacira (Zilretta net sales of $12.7 million are recognised by Pacira from this date to 31 December 2021)
Change Healthcare cyberattack begins: a national claims-clearinghouse outage that disrupted claims submission
source: AHA Change Healthcare cyberattack timeline (data/raw/New Datasets/Event Timeline); HHS readout of 12 March 2024

description: Dip in IQVIA visit volumes across the data (observed in our exploratory analysis; the cause is unverified, and the claims outage is a hypothesis only)
Supplemental application S-021 submitted: room-temperature storage period shortened from six weeks to three weeks
source: FDA supplement approval letter for NDA 208845/S-021; data/raw/New Datasets/FDA Zilretta/208845Orig1s021ltr_2024.pdf
